images.prompt:
Original adult colouring-book illustration in crisp hand-inked black line art on clean white paper; elegant organic contours, fine-to-medium varied outlines, slightly bolder focal silhouettes, and softly handmade yet precise line quality. Use moderately detailed, open colourable forms with selective botanical texture, sparse hatching and delicate repeat patterns; no grey shading, gradients or solid fills. Maintain a calm central hierarchy, balanced decorative framing, generous breathing room and an artisanal, abundant seasonal mood. High-contrast, home-print-friendly monochrome artwork.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Adult colouring-book ink illustration with an artisanal harvest-market feel; clean monochrome drawings built from graceful organic contours and decorative botanical styling.; line weight: Fine-to-medium black outlines with a restrained variation in weight; slightly bolder exterior silhouettes and focal contours.; line quality: Crisp, confident hand-inked strokes with gently irregular handmade character; smooth curves, tidy joins and clearly enclosed colourable areas.; detail level: Moderately detailed, concentrating pattern and texture in selected natural surfaces, foliage and decorative accents while preserving broad open areas for relaxed colouring.; background density: Light to moderate. Supporting details form airy frames, borders or small clusters around the central motif, never filling every gap or competing with the focal area.; composition: Clear central hierarchy with one immediately readable focal grouping; balanced, stable arrangements; decorative elements guide the eye inward; purposeful white space and optional calm header space for titles.; palette: Monochrome black ink on bright white paper only.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No grey fills, gradients or solid black shadow masses. Suggest depth through sparse contour lines, selective hatching and simple repeating textures only.; texture: Subtle hand-drawn organic texture through vein lines, woodgrain-like marks, gentle stippling and small repeat motifs; keep all textures open and colourable.; mood: Calm, abundant, wholesome and quietly celebratory; refined seasonal warmth without spooky, childish or rustic-cliché treatment..

PAGE 2 of "Harvest Market: Autumn Colouring Pages" (colouring): Centred slatted wooden market crate overflowing with exactly 18 distinct apples; exactly three pears, two small squash and two tied herb bundles arranged around the crate; sparse apple branches and fallen leaves framing the display; open woodgrain on crate slats, simple apple stems and leaf-vein details; no wording.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Each page uses a comfortable clear outer margin, with a single calm harvest-market focal composition and open enclosed areas for relaxed adult colouring. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any Halloween, spooky, occult or horror imagery; Characters, faces or anthropomorphic objects; Photorealism, colour, grey wash, gradients or painted shading; Dense clutter, tiny inaccessible details or heavily inked black areas; Trademarked packaging, recognisable logos, branded labels or copied market signage; Copied compositions or distinctive artwork from existing colouring books; Misspelled, distorted or illegible text; Uneven broken outlines, muddy intersections or unclosed colourable shapes.
